question: Can the divisions of this wheel ever be counted?
premises: This wheel contains endless rays and spokes.
The divisions of the wheel depend on that endless structure.
What depends on an endless structure cannot be fully enumerated.
inference: The divisions of the wheel are uncountable because they arise from an endless array within it.
plain_english: Because this wheel rests on endless rays and spokes within it, the divisions of the wheel can never be counted.
